name: Uncharted Space
window: ACTION
text: Draw 1 random unused red tile and place it on the edge of the game board so that it is adjacent to 2 other tiles. If that system contains no other planets, place a frontier token in it.

name: Ancient Maps
window: ACTION
text: Purge 2 relic fragments and draw 1 random unused blue tile. Place it on the edge of the game board so that it is adjacent to 2 other tiles.

name: Dark Energy Spike
window: When you explore a planet you control
text: Explore the frontier deck in that system.

name: Overlooked Findings
window: When you explore a planet you control
text: Place 1 card from the discard pile of that explore deck on top of its respective deck.

name: Mass Hypnosis
window: At the start of a round of space combat
text: Select 1 ship your opponent controls in that system. During this round of combat, hits produced by that unit are assigned to your opponent's units instead.

name: Mirror Shielding
window: At the end of a round of combat
text: Produce hits against your opponent's units equal to the number of hits you canceled during that round of combat.

name: Extension Refit
window: ACTION
text: Remove 1 attachment from a planet you control and reattach it to a non-home non-legendary planet you control.

name: Initiative Outpost
window: ACTION
text: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control. When that planet is exhausted during the action phase, you may draw 1 action card.

name: Exploration Outpost
window: ACTION
text: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control. When that planet is exhausted during the action phase, you may explore 1 other planet you control.

name: Assembly Outpost
window: ACTION
text: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control. When that planet is exhausted during the action phase, you may produce 1 unit in that planet's system.

name: Market Outpost
window: ACTION
text: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control. When that planet is exhausted during the action phase, choose 1 other player. You both gain 1 trade good and may perform a transaction.

name: Tactical Retreat
window: When a player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your ships
text: Move up to 2 of your non-fighter ships from the active system into an adjacent system that contains no other player's ships. Those ships may transport units.

name: Rigged Explosives
window: When a system that contains your ground forces is activated
text: Up to 5 of your ground forces in the active system gain SPACE CANNON equal to their COMBAT value until the end of that action. Ground forces that use SPACE CANNON but do not produce at least 1 hit are destroyed.

name: Raised Morale
window: At the start of a round of combat or when you would use a unit ability
text: Treat each of your damaged units in that combat as galvanized until the end of that combat.

name: Relitigate
window: At the start of the agenda phase
text: Select 1 agenda in the discard pile. Players immediately vote on that agenda as if it had just been revealed.

name: Demoralizing Environment
window: At the start of a round of combat
text: Apply -2 to each of your opponent's non-fighter combat rolls during this combat round.

name: Dedicated Study
window: ACTION
text: Purge 1 non-faction non-unit technology with 2 or more prerequisites. Then, research 2 other technologies in the same color with a combined number of prerequisites equal to that technology.

name: Borrowed Time
window: At the end of your turn
text: Spend up to 2 trade goods. Skip that many of your next turns.

name: Political Marriage
window: At the start of another player's turn
text: That player cannot activate a system that contains your units during that turn.

name: Enlistment
window: ACTION
text: Place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on a non-home planet adjacent to 1 or more of your units. Then, resolve combat on that planet.

name: Combat Initiative
window: ACTION
text: Perform a tactical action in a system using a token from your reinforcements. During that tactical action, you may only move 1 non-fighter ship.

name: Precision Targeting
window: At the start of a round of space combat
text: Choose 2 non-fighter ships your opponent controls in the active system. At least 1 hit produced by your units during this combat round must be assigned to those ships, if able.

name: Orbital Evacuation
window: After another player commits ground forces to a planet you control
text: Remove each of your ground forces from planets you control in the active system and place them on other planets you control.

name: Administrative Exemption
window: When you would resolve the secondary ability of a strategy card
text: You do not have to spend a command token.

name: Emergency Appropriations
window: When you spend resources
text: You can spend influence as if it were resources.

name: Wildlife Preservation
window: When you spend influence
text: You can spend resources as if it were influence.

name: Prototype Deployment
window: After you research a non-war sun unit upgrade technology
text: Place 1 unit of that type from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your space docks, or on a planet you control if that unit is a ground force or structure.

name: Retrofitting
window: When a system is activated
text: Gain 1 unit upgrade technology. Return that technology to your technology deck at the end of that tactical action.

name: Senate Gridlock
window: After all players have voted on an agenda, before resolving its outcome
text: If you cast at least 1 vote for an outcome, you may cast additional votes for that outcome equal to the number of votes 1 other player cast on a different outcome.

name: Exploration Rider
window: After an agenda is revealed
text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud the outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, explore 1 planet you conrol of each trait.

name: Archaeologist Co-op
window: When you explore a planet you control
text: You also explore each other planet you control in that system.

name: Deconstructed Militia
window: At the end of movement
text: Remove 1 non-fighter ship with a cost of 4 or less from the active system. Place fighters in the active system with a combined cost equal to that unit's cost.

name: Collaborative Research
window: ACTION
text: Select 1 player. Each of you may spend 2 trade goods. If you both do, you may research 1 non-faction technology that player does not own. If you do, that player gains that technology.

name: Shared Resources
window: When you exhaust a planet you control
text: Treat it as if it had the resource value of 1 other planet you control.
notes: This must be played after exhausting a planet.

name: Forward Assembly
window: When you produce 1 or more units
text: You may place any number of those units in an adjacent system that contains 1 or more of your ships and no other players' ships.
notes: For best results, play after producing, before paying.

name: Priority Requisition
window: When you produce 1 or more units
text: Return 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system to your reinforcements. Reduce the combined cost of the produced units by the cost of the returned ship +2.
notes: For best results, play before paying, after producing.

name: Ecological Survey
window: When you would explore a planet
text: Look at the top card of each exploration deck. Choose 1 to resolve and discard the rest.

name: Transit Rider
window: After an agenda is revealed
text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud the outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, perform a tactical action in a system containing no other player's units without spending a command token. Unit abilities cannot be used during this tactical action.

name: Flank Speed
window: After you activate a system
text: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.
flavorText: Mendosa smirked. "Don't ye fret now, girl. It sounds like ye've got somewhere ta be in a hurry, and it just se happens that I ken get ye there right quick."
wildWildText: Apply +2 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Direct Hit
window: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities
text: Destroy that ship.
flavorText: There it was! An opening! Neekuaq gestured wildly, a rare display for one normally quite reserved. "Fire the main battery!"
wildWildWindow: After another player's ship or mech uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities

name: Maneuvering Jets
window: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll
text: Cancel 1 hit.
flavorText: Something was wrong. T'esla sensed a flicker of movement on the planet's surface, followed by a faint glint of light. Reflexively, she veered her fighter to the side - an action that saved her life.
wildWildWindow: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll

name: Morale Boost
window: At the start of a combat round
text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
flavorText: Harrugh stood before his warriors, searching for the words that would express the pride that swelled within him.
wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
wildWildText: Apply +2 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

name: Sabotage
window: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'
text: Cancel that action card.
flavorText: Q'uesh Sish tapped her claws impatiently. "You were sssaying?" But the confused Jol-Nar envoy stood silent. It was as if the words had escaped his thoughts entirely.
wildWildWindow: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage'
wildWildText: Cancel that action card, and then take that card into your hand.

name: Shields Holding
window: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat
text: Cancel up to 2 hits.
flavorText: T'ro stared unflinching at the incoming barrage through the bridge's observation deck. The shield would hold.
wildWildWindow: Before you assign hits to your unit during a combat (space or ground)

name: Skilled Retreat
window: At the start of a combat round
notes: This may only be played during space combat
text: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.
flavorText: In an instant, the Sol fleet vanished from the Barony's scanners.
wildWildWindow: At the start of a combat round
wildWildText: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Do not place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

name: War Machine
window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
text: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
flavorText: This would take weeks to replace if you had run it backwards, Varish called as she rotated the massive capacitor bank. "Okay, fire it up."
wildWildWindow: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
wildWildText: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 5.

name: Diplomatic Pressure
window: When an agenda is revealed
text: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.
notes: One player cannot play multiple of these targeting the same player during the same agenda.
flavorText: The Arborec emissary leaned close, and Brother Milor flinched at the faint whiff of decay. "You do not understand," Dirzuga Ohao rasped. "You must support this measure."
wildWildText: Choose another player. That player must give you 3 promissory notes from their hand.

name: Pirate Contract
window: Action
text: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.
flavorText: Suffi accepted the contract, swearing her solemn vow that she would see the viceroy's daughter kidnapped and held for ransom by the day's end.

name: Strategize
window: Action
text: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.
notes: When resolving the chosen secondary ability, you must still spend the strategy token, except for Leadership. You must declare which strategy card you are choosing before the Sabo window, but need not declare how you will resolve the secondary ability.
flavorText: Kyver stared Mathis in the eye, unblinking. For a time, neither made a move. The greens and browns of Kyver's eyes were impassive. They betrayed nothing of his intent. Nothing of his past or his future. They were but windows to the wild, unforgiving jungles of Retillion.
